scientific_scope_status: On the admitted graph, monotonicity replaces arbitrary future-dependent supported labels by one all-wrong Markov trajectory. For n bits, q-bit supports, initial errors<=n/256, per-bit Poisson incidence lambda<=1/[1024(2^q-1)] and clock rates in[15/16,17/16], the claimed all-time register failure is at most2^q n(1+lambda)T exp(-n/256). A buffered-copy receiver has separate initialization-forgetting and excursion terms.
